text:
harper: quick alert — after rolling L7 tighten to eu4 this morning, ~28 staging GPU nodes are stuck JOIN_PENDING. Keystore-proxy reports repeated 502/504; KMS decrypt latency spikes, and audit-forwarder has queued millions of events. conntrack on natgw-d at ~96%. Anyone seeing this pattern?
infra-bot: [ALERT] keystore-proxy.decrypt_backpressure eu4 - severity=high - 2026-03-25T06:15:02Z
own: seeing it — packet captures show TLS reassembly/DPI holding state and many TCP_RETRANS to 172.31.40.0/24. Short-lived provisioning TLS sessions are getting broken mid-handshake.
ina: compliance insisted on default-deny at L7 so we can't revert. Proposed fast mitigation: scoped security exception for provisioning-subnet -> keystore-proxy:443, bound to role arn:aws:iam::redwood:role/provisioner via IAM condition, and automated revoke after 45m using a small lambda. Also enable audit-sampling=10% for tag:onboarding to stop sink thrash.
zack: added short-term conntrack bump on natgw hosts and enabled a tiny local keystore cache (ttl 20s) on bootstrap path. Commands I ran: ```sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=240000
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_buckets=24000```
own: after SG exception + conntrack bump, first few nodes joined. KMS decrypt p50 ~180ms, p95 ~800ms, conntrack dropped to 61%.
harper: good. cost tradeoff: if we move non-critical staging to us-west-2 warmpool for ~60m, estimate egress/image-pull ~30-60 USD vs potential lost GPU prewarm ~300 USD. billing-bot, flag cost delta.
billing-bot: Notice: estimated migration cost for 28 nodes -> us-west-2 for 60m ~ $45. Logging/egress spike remediation estimated savings ~ $260 in avoided warmup waste.
harper: ok keep exception window limited. nina, open sec-exception ticket and attach ACL PR with IAM condition + auto-revoke lambda. Put runbook note: when you see TCP_RETRANS + SACK to keystore + audit-forwarder retries, check DPI rules and conntrack.
infra-bot: Incident INC-20260325-07 logged: eu4 keystore/DPI causing conntrack + audit backlog. Assigned: harper, nina, owen.
nina: PR opened and lambda set to revoke after 45m. Will post link and runbook snippet when ready.
harper: thanks — will collect metrics for postmortem: total joins delayed, keystore decrypt QPS, audit-forwarder queue depth, conntrack peak, and cost impact. :thumbsup:
